records.title: Another
records.synopsis:
*[Another](/book/43248)* was first serialized intermittently between the August 2006 and May 2009 issues of Kadokawa Shoten's literary magazine *Shosetsu Yasei Jidai*. *[Another 2001](/book/43250)* was also first serialized between the November 2014 and February 2020 issues of the same magazine.

In the afterword of *Another 2001*, the author revealed he had a concept for a planned sequel, which would be the last in the series, though he also stated he'd like to take a break from the series first.

Adapted into a four-volume manga, with a fifth spin-off volume titled *Another 0*, by [Kiyohara Hiro](/staff/3435).

Adapted into a 12-episode anime by P.A. Works.

Adapted into a live-action film directed by Furusawa Takeshi and produced by Kadokawa Pictures.

####Acclaim
Ranked third in the 2010 edition of [Takarajimasha's](/publisher/100) *Kono Mystery ga Sugoi!* guidebook and third again in the 2021 edition.

Ranked third in the 2010 edition of Hara Shobo's *Honkaku Mystery Best 10* guidebook.

Nominated for the 2010 Honkaku Mystery Award, receiving 15 votes.

Nominated for the 2010 Yamada Futaro Award.

Ranked 15th in 2010, 166th in 2014, and 50th in 2021 in the first round voting of the Japan Booksellers' Award.

records.title: Arcadia Garden
records.synopsis:
This is also the first light novel apart of the [Utopia project](https://over-lap.co.jp/bunko/arcadiagarden/), an intertwining project which consisted of 10 authors, where each wrote their own stories and characters that existed in the same world.

Others from this same project are: *[Saviour's Garden](https://over-lap.co.jp/bunko/arcadiagarden/sav), [Historia Garden](https://over-lap.co.jp/bunko/arcadiagarden/his/), Kill the Giant Tree!, Two Flames, The Window Manager Is Depressed Today As Well, Empty Atalante, Bad Guy on Hard Rack, Two Wands and One Daughter,* and *Magician Johnny.*

It seems that *[The Faraway Paladin](https://ranobedb.org/series/5457)* was also part of it, according to the afterword of [vol. 1](https://ranobedb.org/book/17127).

records.title: All You Need Is Kill
records.synopsis:
One of the four launch titles of [Viz Media's](/publisher/48) [Haikasoru](/publisher/462) imprint, alongside *ZOO* by [Otsuichi](/staff/299), *Usurper of the Sun* by Nojiri Hosuke, and *The Lord of the Sands of Time* by [Ogawa Issui](/staff/537).

In an interview published in the May 2014 issue of [Shueisha's](/publisher/1) *Miracle Jump* magazine, the author announced he was working on a sequel, though no further updates have been released since then.

Loosely adapted into a 2014 American live-action film by Doug Liman, starring Tom Cruise and Emily Blunt. The film differs significantly from the novel, particularly in the second half. Liman rejected the novel's title and wanted to name the film *Live Die Repeat*, but Warner Bros. Pictures decided to use that as the tagline, instead renaming the film *Edge of Tomorrow*. A sequel to the film has been announced, with the working title *Live Die Repeat and Repeat*.

Adapted into a manga by [Obata Takeshi](/staff/13036) based on character designs by [ABe Yoshitoshi](/staff/607), and storyboarding by [Takeuchi Ryosuke](/staff/7156).

Adapted into an American graphic novel by Nick Mamatas and illustrated by Lee Ferguson.


####Awards
Nominated for the "Best Japanese Long Work" category at the 36th Seiun Awards in 2005.
